calling.heading: CALLING
calling.quote: We are not called to be comfortable. We are called to be courageous.

body.value: I am a pastor, teacher, and author dedicated to breaking down complex theological concepts for the modern believer.

From my time ministering in New Zealand to returning to my roots in Statesville, I bring a global perspective and a local heart to teaching the Word as the Lead Pastor at Cornerstone Church in Statesville, NC.

faq.supportBody: No worries! If you have any other questions or need more information, feel free to reach out directly to contact@calebgriffith.com.

items.q: I want Caleb to speak at my event. Who do I contact?
items.a: Head to the Book Caleb page and send us the details of your event. Our team reviews every request and will get back to you within a few business days.

items.q: I ordered merch and have an inquiry. Who do I talk to?
items.a: Email contact@calebgriffith.com with your order number and we'll sort it out right away.

items.q: How do I support what you guys are doing?
items.a: Prayer, sharing our content, and giving all make a real difference. Every bit helps us reach more people with the message.

items.q: I don't have extra funds to donate. How else can I help?
items.a: Share our videos, invite a friend to listen, and keep us in your prayers. Generosity isn't only financial.

about.name: Caleb Griffith
about.intro: Raised in church, Caleb carried a deep faith but wrestled with depression and anxiety for years.

story.value: One night, at his breaking point, Caleb made a plan to end his life. But in that moment, instead of darkness, he encountered Jesus in a life-altering way. Rather than giving up, he gave his life to the One who had been reaching out all along.

Since that night, Caleb has dedicated his life to sharing the gospel with millions—both online and in person. His mission is simple: to bring the hope he found to others, sharing the light and love of Jesus wherever he goes. Caleb's journey is a testament to the power of faith, the resilience of hope, and the boundless love of God.

about.quoteText: It wasn't until I reached the end of my own strength that I discovered grace had been holding me the entire time.
